plan.purpose: Predeclared paired mean-throughflow boundary comparison, not calibration
plan.wind_source: Both archived simulated lower and upper projected-right/up winds, not observed/reference wind. Lower pressure cell uses lower source; all other cells use upper source. Arithmetic staggering, up converted to grid-south.
plan.paired_control: Same source baroclinic shear, temperature, water, Earth rotation, drag, time grid and incoming T/q. Closed ports remove boundary mean; open ports retain globally balanced archived mean. Interior initial projection differs only in mean flow required by the declared boundary.
plan.boundary: Source baroclinic shear identical across cases; only the global-mass-balanced boundary mean differs. Not transparent radiation or a global circulation model. Incoming T/q fixed at initial adjacent model values.
plan.unchanged: Prior post-conversion T/water, Earth rotation, five-day drag, one-hour convective relaxation, pressure grid,224km sampling, source baroclinic shear and incoming T/q. Only mean boundary flow and its required initial mean projection differ; no sustained solar/surface evaporation.
plan.dynamics: Rigid-lid CN pressure constraint permits nonzero mean wind with zero column divergence. Constraint pressure does no work. No nonlinear momentum advection, variable surface pressure or full balanced initialization.
plan.counts: 12 new6h Earth-input smoke integrations if all start; prior42 starts/38completions/4retained numerical failures. Expected cumulative54 starts if complete. No legacy benchmark attempts or monthly scores added.
plan.failures: Preserve all declared attempts and partial states; no replacement cases or post-outcome source changes
plan.numerical_change: Same3LU residual corrections; rowwise backward error uses separate mass-weighted-velocity and constraint-potential infinity norms to handle exact zero transverse modes.8eps guard; native physical mass/energy tolerances unchanged.
plan.prior_attempt: Both original rigid-lid attempts preserved; this is a new physical boundary comparison, not a repeat or replacement.
plan.port_preparation: Both simulated archived layer winds retained. Raw normal boundary ports receive explicit minimum-kinetic uniform barotropic outward-speed correction to zero net regional dry mass. Original kg/s, correction m/s and corrected kg/s recorded. No correction inside the model; unbalanced input rejected.
plan.initialization: Nearest mass-weighted initial interior wind satisfying D*x=-d_boundary. Affine projection can add or remove KE; signed change recorded separately, no heat compensation or balanced-initialization claim.
plan.energy: Constraint-pressure internal work plus outward boundary constraint-geopotential work cancel. Total boundary geopotential term includes thermal and constraint parts; both separately saved.
